title: site.env.write — restore a site's secrets on the tmpfs (after a reboot) without deploying

release_id.description: The live release the secrets belong to (ULID). Refused when it is no longer current (classic sites), not on the server (compose) or no container of the site runs it (secret files).

content.description: dotenv content of the live release (secret)

env_file.description: Restored only when missing (an existing file is newer): /run/falak/env/<site>.env (0440, site user and group), shared/<path> (re)made a symlink to it; with `compose`, compose-<site>.env (0400 root)

compose.description: env_file is the compose project's (/run/falak/env/compose-<site>.env, which the releases link to)

secret_files.description: Restored into the missing secret directory of each container labelled falak.site=<site> and falak.release.id=<release_id> with secret files (existing directories are never touched); a container that could not start without them is started.

after.description: Run in the current release with bash once the files are back, e.g. `php artisan config:cache` (the config cache lives on the tmpfs too)

name.description: php version, unit name, program name, or the site slug for site_procs (restarts the site's programs)

reload.description: Reloads after the files are written: the processes that read the env at start

mask.description: Names of the secret variables in this payload. The agent looks their values up in the payload (env maps, dotenv content) and masks them, plus their base64 and URL-encoded forms, as •••• in the command's output, error and result. Values shorter than 6 bytes are not masked.

containers.description: Containers whose secret files were written
